Results.ReviewText:
I bought this in April and it’s a fairly good trimmer. It is on the heavy side so invest in a shoulder strap. What I don’t really like about it is the fact that it takes some time for the head to start spinning once you squeeze the throttle . In my experience I had to squeeze the throttle about halfway just to get it to spin therefore in order to get the power I needed I had to pretty much hold it down all the way the entire time I was weed eating. For me that causes a lot of arm fatigue. 
The same week I used a neighbor’s electric trimmer and got immediate power upon squeezing the throttle and it had near gas power (on a low setting). And I only used about 1/4 throttle the entire time. I won’t say the name of the electric trimmer I used but I will say I was able to do my entire 1/2 acre yard without any arm fatigue and the said electric trimmer still had plenty of battery juice left. Needless to say I switched from gas to electric shortly after. Even though this Wild Badger is decent I’ll likely pass it on to someone who just prefers a gas trimmer. Despite the fact that this 4 stroke is quieter than a two stroke that electric one was even quieter . This did start on the first pull also.

Results.OriginalProductName: 31cc String Trimmer 4-Stroke 31cc Brush Cutter Blade Gas Shoulder Strap String Trimmer Rubber Handle
Results.ReviewText: I bought this one year ago to replace a difficult to start 2 stroke line trimmer. This thing starts up on first or second pull. Make sure the ignition switch on the handle is in the on position (it remains in position unlike other machines with spring loaded switches). after it starts let it run on choke for 30 seconds then move to choke off position. The other great feature is the easy windup reloadable line spool. remove the spool by pushing together the plastic tabs then rotate the inside spool so the arrows and openings go clear through. push 6' of line through with even line on each side then windup the spool in direction of the arrows to finish loading the line.  easy peasy. the badger is heavier than a two stroke but not beyond most folks' lifting ability. BTW change oil as needed with synthetic and use fresh non ethanol gas.  Recommended.

311424786.Description: Stop mixing oil and gas and take control of your lawn care with the powerful and versatile Wild Badger Power 4-Cycle Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass Trimmer and Brush Cutter. This tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. It also includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. Powered by a 31cc, 4-cycle, full-crank engine, your trimmer is designed for reliability. The full crank design delivers a fast start and smooth operation reducing emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by an aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube which is lightweight and durable for added comfort and convenience. The twist-n-load bump feed trimmer head allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawn and landscaping looking clean.
